name: Production Plant Data for Condition Monitoring
summary: Condition-monitoring data from eight run-to-failure experiments on eight important production-plant components.

attributes.name: Timestamp
attributes.description: Time index indicating observation order within an experiment.

attributes.name: L_1..L_10
attributes.description: Paired current- and speed-related signals for five components.

attributes.name: A_1..A_5
attributes.description: Five measurements associated with the sixth component.

attributes.name: B_1..B_5
attributes.description: Five measurements associated with the seventh component.

attributes.name: C_1..C_5
attributes.description: Five measurements associated with the eighth component.

attributes.name: trial/component
attributes.description: Experiment and component identifier C7, C8, C9, C11, C13, C14, C15, or C16, represented by the file name.

notes: C7 and C13 each span two files separated by a short interruption.
Failure time and RUL are not directly labeled and require interpretation based on experiment endpoints and expert assessments.
citation: von Birgelen, A. et al. (2018). Self-Organizing Maps for Anomaly Localization and Predictive Maintenance in Cyber-Physical Production Systems.
